components.name: Primary Pagination
components.html: <button class="ds-primary">Nächste Etappe <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h16m-6-6 6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-primary{font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:.8rem;padding:11px 16px;border-radius:5px;min-height:42px;display:inline-flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;background:var(--lavender, #b4acf0);color:#201a34;border:1px solid var(--lavender, #b4acf0);font-weight:600}.ds-primary:hover{background:#d0c8ff}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--lavender, #b4acf0);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default}

components.name: Outline Tool
components.css: .ds-outline{font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:.8rem;padding:11px 16px;border-radius:5px;min-height:42px;display:inline-flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;background:transparent;color:var(--text, #edeaf5);border:1px solid var(--line, #49445f)}.ds-outline:hover{background:#332c45}.ds-outline:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--lavender, #b4acf0);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-outline:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default}.ds-outline.ds-danger{color:#f7b3a5;border-color:#a5696a}

components.name: Text Action
components.description: A quiet cross-reference or resume action.

components.name: Build Picker
components.description: Adjacent named choices with a tonal selected state.
components.css: .ds-build-picker{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;border:1px solid var(--line, #49445f);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;color:var(--text, #edeaf5)}.ds-build-picker button{font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;border:0;padding:21px 20px;min-height:93px;background:transparent;text-align:left;color:var(--text, #edeaf5);cursor:pointer}.ds-build-picker button+button{border-left:1px solid var(--line, #49445f)}.ds-build-picker button:hover{background:#282536}.ds-build-picker button.ds-build-active{background:#302c43}.ds-build-picker strong{display:block;font-family:Chivo, system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:1.16rem;font-weight:600}.ds-build-picker small{display:block;font-size:.74rem;color:var(--muted, #bab4cd);line-height:1.4;margin-top:4px}.ds-build-picker button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--lavender, #b4acf0);outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Notes Field
components.description: Personal notes on a quiet inset ground.
components.html: <label class="ds-notes-label" for="ds-notes">Meine Notizen</label><textarea class="ds-notes" id="ds-notes" placeholder="Fehlende Punkte oder entdeckte Händler …"></textarea>
components.css: .ds-notes-label{font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;color:var(--text, #edeaf5);font-size:.83rem}.ds-notes{font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;display:block;width:100%;min-height:150px;background:var(--panel, #201e2e);border:1px solid var(--line, #49445f);border-radius:5px;padding:15px;color:var(--text, #edeaf5);line-height:1.7;resize:vertical;font-size:.88rem;caret-color:var(--lavender, #b4acf0)}.ds-notes::placeholder{color:#b4acc4}.ds-notes:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--lavender, #b4acf0);outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Stage Register
components.description: Numbered stage navigation with a selected tonal row.
components.css: .ds-stages{background:var(--rail, #26233c);padding:4px}.ds-stages button{font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;width:100%;min-height:36px;text-align:left;gap:10px;padding:7px 9px;font-size:.78rem;background:transparent;border:0;border-radius:4px;color:#d1cade;line-height:1.3;cursor:pointer}.ds-stages button:hover{background:#343047;color:#fff}.ds-stages button.ds-selected{background:#524873;color:#fff;animation:ds-place-marker .22s ease-out}.ds-stage-marker{flex:0 0 23px;text-align:center;font-size:.66rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:#b4abc9;transition:color .18s ease-out}.ds-selected .ds-stage-marker{color:#e0d6ff}.ds-next-dot{width:5px;height:5px;background:var(--accent, #dfa78d);border-radius:50%;margin-left:auto}.ds-stages button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--lavender, #b4acf0);outline-offset:4px;}@keyframes ds-place-marker{from{background:#6a598a}to{background:#524873}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-stages button{animation:none}.ds-stage-marker{transition:none}}

components.name: View Tabs
components.description: A flat underline distinguishes the current reference view.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:22px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:nowrap;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, #49445f)}.ds-tabs button{font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:.83rem;padding:13px 0 15px;background:transparent;border:0;color:var(--muted, #bab4cd);position:relative;cursor:pointer}.ds-tabs button:hover{color:var(--text, #edeaf5)}.ds-tabs button.ds-tab-active{color:var(--lavender, #b4acf0)}.ds-tab-active:after{content:"";position:absolute;height:2px;background:var(--lavender, #b4acf0);inset:auto 0 0}.ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--lavender, #b4acf0);outline-offset:-2px}

components.name: Checklist Row
components.description: An open reading row with an explicit completion mark.
components.css: .ds-check-row{font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:13px;padding:13px 0;cursor:pointer;font-size:.93rem;line-height:1.65;color:var(--text, #edeaf5)}.ds-check-row span{max-width:74ch}.ds-check-row input{margin:5px 0 0;appearance:none;width:19px;height:19px;flex:0 0 19px;border:1px solid #82768f;background:transparent;border-radius:3px;position:relative;cursor:pointer}.ds-check-row input:checked{background:var(--accent, #dfa78d);border-color:var(--accent, #dfa78d)}.ds-check-row input:checked:after{content:"";position:absolute;width:9px;height:5px;border-left:2px solid var(--ground, #171622);border-bottom:2px solid var(--ground, #171622);transform:rotate(-45deg);left:4px;top:4px}.ds-check-row input:checked+span{color:var(--muted, #bab4cd)}.ds-check-row input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--lavender, #b4acf0);outline-offset:4px;}

narrative.overview:
Night Atlas is a quiet expedition register: indigo navigation beside an aubergine reading ground, with mist lavender numerals that make the current place easy to find. Peach and mint distinguish the two builds without replacing written names or completion marks.

Self-hosted Chivo headings give the atlas its restrained voice; system sans-serif keeps German instructions comfortable to read beside the game. Thin rules, open rows and flat tonal surfaces provide structure. This code-first system has no approved image composition or shipping raster assets; review screenshots are QA evidence.
keyCharacteristics: Indigo register and aubergine reading ground.
Lavender numbering; peach Wolf and mint Lady accents.
Restrained Chivo headings and comfortable sans-serif reading text.
Flat tonal depth, open rows and explicit completion marks.

rules.name: The Build Accent Rule
rules.body: Use peach for Wolf and mint for Lady; keep lavender for navigation and numbering. Pair color with names and status marks.

rules.name: The Reading Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Chivo for headings and prominent route numbers; keep instructions and controls in the system sans-serif stack.

rules.name: The Flat Atlas Rule
rules.body: Separate regions with tonal fields and thin rules. Do not add decorative shadows or simulated parchment.

dos: Do preserve the indigo register, aubergine reading field and lavender numbering.
Do pair build accents and completion colors with written names, numbers or explicit marks.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and disable marker motion when reduced motion is requested.
Do keep long instructions in open reading rows with the observed comfortable line length.
donts: Don't replace Chivo headings with a system display face.
Don't introduce decorative fantasy parchment, bevels or dashboard-style tile grids.
Don't use screenshots as shipping artwork or invent a raster-led composition.
